definitions.gloss: visiting a shrine, temple, or grave; paying one's respects; pilgrimage
definitions.explanation: The act of visiting a Shinto shrine, Buddhist temple, or family grave to pray, make offerings, or pay respects. A routine part of Japanese cultural life.

examples.japanese: {初詣|はつもうで}でお{参|まい}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went to pray at a shrine for New Year's.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧{近|ちか}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧お{参|まい}り⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I visit the nearby shrine to pray every morning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父母|そふぼ}→祖父母：03110_sofubo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{墓|はか}→お墓：21734_ohaka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧お{参|まい}り⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: After visiting our grandparents' grave, we had a meal as a family.

notes:
USAGE:
Used as a suru-verb: お{参|まい}り⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧. Applies to both shrine and temple visits, as well as visiting graves (⟦{墓参|はかまい}り→墓参り：10663_hakamairi⟧). The お prefix is standard and usually not dropped.

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japanese people commonly visit shrines at New Year (⟦{初詣|はつもうで}→初詣：05804_hatsumoude⟧), during festivals, and for life events like ⟦{七五三|しちごさん}→七五三：06185_shichigosan⟧. Visiting family graves (⟦{墓参|はかまい}り→墓参り：10663_hakamairi⟧) is customary during ⟦お{盆|ぼん}→お盆：05587_obon⟧ and the equinoxes.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- お{参|まい}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ (to go pray at a shrine/temple)
- ⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧お{参|まい}り⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to visit a shrine)
- ⟦お{墓|はか}{参|まい}り→お墓参り：15303_ohakamairi⟧ (visiting a grave)
